policy.title: Returns and exchanges policy
policy.description: Learn about Core Care return conditions, excluded products, and refund methods.
policy.help_title: Need help with a return request?
policy.help_description: Contact Core Care customer service through your order ticket or the approved contact channel, and we will help you at every step.
policy.intro: Your satisfaction matters to us. Core Care returns damaged products or compensates you with wallet credit, including shipping.
policy.devices: Devices can be returned provided they have not been used or opened and remain in their original condition as received from Core Care.
policy.fees_answer:
The return fee for an undamaged product is SAR 19, paid by the customer and deducted from the returned product's value.
For a damaged product, Core Care pays the full return fee.
policy.damaged_question: How can I return a damaged product?
policy.damaged_answer:
Contact Core Care customer service through your order ticket or the approved contact channel.
The product and its original packaging must be kept intact, and the product must not be used, opened, or repackaged.
policy.offers_question: Can I return a damaged product purchased during a Core Care promotion?
policy.offers_answer: A damaged product purchased during a Core Care promotion is compensated with a new product or wallet credit for the product's value, without transfer to a bank account.
policy.lenses_question: Can I return contact lenses in their original condition?
policy.lenses_answer: No. For your safety, contact lenses cannot be returned even in their original condition.
policy.deadline_question: How long do I have to return a damaged product?
policy.deadline_answer: Damaged products can be returned within 7 days of purchase.
policy.processing_question: How long does a damaged product return take?
policy.processing_answer: Processing a damaged product return may take up to 10 business days.
policy.payment_question: How will I receive my refund?
policy.payment_answer:
Refunds are processed after the product reaches Core Care and is inspected.
Credit card payments are refunded to the wallet or bank account. Cash on delivery payments are refunded as wallet credit.
policy.qitaf_question: Can Qitaf points be refunded to a bank account?
policy.qitaf_answer: Qitaf points converted to Core Care wallet credit cannot be transferred to a bank account.
policy.rajhi_question: Can Al Rajhi rewards be refunded to a bank account?
policy.rajhi_answer: Al Rajhi rewards converted to Core Care wallet credit cannot be transferred to a bank account.
policy.temporary_question: Can temporary credit be refunded to a bank account?
policy.temporary_answer: Temporary credit cannot be refunded or transferred to a bank account.
policy.license_description: You can view the details of the Core Care promotional license in the attached document.
policy.exclusions_lead: For your safety, Core Care does not accept returns of:
policy.exclusion_lenses: Contact lenses, even in their original condition
policy.refund_lead: Refunds are processed after the product reaches Core Care and is inspected, according to the payment method:
policy.refund_card_value: To the wallet or bank account
